entries.previousAppearance: The Unknown, adult RED-SKINNED half-demon with yellow eyes, tiny gold circular forehead mark, swept-back black curved horns, long pale white hair, dark lower-face scarf/mouth wrap, dark fitted leather-and-bone battle armour and boots, red-black bat wings and pointed tail. Complete pale ivory/gray bone-clad Terminus blade with ornate skull-like hilt and small red details; NO white skull face or flaming red broadsword.
entries.appearance: The Unknown has a SMOOTH BALD RED HEAD, THREE bright YELLOW EYES (two ordinary eyes and a smaller actual third eye centered on the forehead), black sclera, rough black-brown/ivory fossil-like horns, dark lower-face wrap, dark blue-gray shoulder cowl with SHORT GRAY FUR TRIM AT THE SHOULDERS, black/dark red armour, red-black bat wings, pointed tail and boots. ABSOLUTELY NO HAIR, ponytail, mane, white hair or skull-white face. She holds the complete ivory bone-clad Terminus sword with ornate skull-like hilt.
entries.reason: The actually viewed official header and root’s independent view confirm bald red scalp, three yellow eyes, shoulder fur and ivory bone sword. White hair in both earlier generated atlases was a mistake; both complete earlier48-pose atlases remain excluded.

entries.previousAppearance: Small floating horned skull Paz with glowing orange eyes, dark cracked bone and warm embers, no torso, arms or legs; compact source skull silhouette.
entries.appearance: Paz is a small complete weathered PALE BONE SKULL with FOUR SHORT BROKEN HORN STUMPS and inscribed source runes, floating without a torso, arms, legs or human clothing. No long intact curling horns. Neutral/resting eye sockets glow BLUE-WHITE; ONLY during actual firebolt release the eyes/runes glow with warm fire. Preserve the complete skull, lower jaw and all short broken horn tips.
entries.reason: Independent franchise reference distinguishes four broken horns and blue/white idle eyes from fire-lit attack eyes. The first generic long-horned permanently orange skull is not accepted. Exact full-source visual comparison remains uncertified; no SVG image was actually viewable locally.

entries.appearance: Alicia Pris, a Felineko girl with WARM TAN/ORANGE face and muzzle, short BLACK hair/fur framing her cheeks, swept WHITE-BLOND front bangs, large black cat ears with pink interiors, one visible BLUE eye and black patch over her RIGHT eye, black cat tail.
